_note: Original wellness-education text written for the +U Table. General emotional literacy for youth; not therapy or medical advice. Review and edit freely; the owner's own wording replaces any entry.

elements.name: Acceptance
elements.definition: Letting a thing be real without fighting it.
elements.negative: If it feels like giving up, remember accepting is not approving; name what you can change next.
elements.positive: Use it to rest, then take one calm step forward.

elements.name: Admiration
elements.definition: Looking up to someone for who they are or what they do.
elements.negative: If it turns into comparing yourself, list one strength of your own.
elements.positive: Ask what you can learn from them and try one small piece.

elements.name: Affection
elements.definition: A warm, caring feeling toward someone.
elements.negative: If it is not returned, give it to yourself and to safe people around you.
elements.positive: Show it with a kind word, a note, or time.

elements.name: Aggravation
elements.definition: Being bothered again and again by the same thing.
elements.negative: Step away, breathe slowly, and name the one thing that keeps repeating.
elements.positive: Turn it into a fix: change the thing or ask for help.

elements.name: Alienation
elements.definition: Feeling like you do not belong with the people around you.
elements.negative: Reach out to one person or find a group built on something you like.
elements.positive: Your difference can be a gift; share it where it is welcome.

elements.name: Amazement
elements.definition: Being struck by something wonderful or unexpected.
elements.negative: If it feels like too much, slow down and take it in a piece at a time.
elements.positive: Tell someone about it; wonder grows when shared.

elements.name: Amusement
elements.negative: If the laughing hurts someone, stop and check in with them.
elements.positive: Laugh together; it lightens hard days.

elements.name: Anger
elements.definition: A strong reaction to something that feels unfair or hurtful.
elements.negative: Pause, breathe, move your body, and speak only after you cool down.
elements.positive: Use it as a signal about what matters, then act with respect.

elements.name: Anguish
elements.definition: Deep pain of mind or heart.
elements.negative: Tell a trusted person and do not carry it alone; ask for help if it will not ease.
elements.positive: Healing often follows being heard; let someone sit with you.

elements.name: Annoyance
elements.negative: Notice the source, take a short break, and let the small stuff go.
elements.positive: Use it as a cue to set a boundary or change a habit.

elements.name: Anticipation
elements.negative: If it turns to dread, plan one small, doable step.
elements.positive: Prepare and enjoy the build-up.

elements.name: Anxiety
elements.definition: A restless worry about what might happen.
elements.negative: Breathe in for four, out for six; ground yourself by naming five things you see.
elements.positive: Turn worry into a short plan and ask for support.

elements.name: Apathy
elements.negative: Start tiny: one five-minute task, and tell someone how you feel.
elements.positive: Small wins rebuild interest; follow what sparks even a little.

elements.name: Appreciation
elements.definition: Recognizing the value of someone or something.
elements.negative: If you feel you must repay it, simply say thank you.
elements.positive: Say it out loud or write it down.

elements.name: Awe
elements.definition: Feeling small in front of something vast or beautiful.
elements.negative: If it feels overwhelming, ground yourself with slow breaths.
elements.positive: Seek it out: sky, music, stories, people at their best.

elements.name: Awkwardness
elements.definition: Feeling out of place in a moment.
elements.negative: Remember almost everyone feels it; breathe and keep going.
elements.positive: A shared laugh or honest comment can turn it into a connection.

elements.name: Betrayal
elements.definition: Feeling hurt when trust was broken.
elements.negative: Give yourself time, protect your boundaries, and talk to someone safe.
elements.positive: You can learn what you need from people and trust again, wisely.

elements.name: Bitterness
elements.definition: Hurt that has hardened into resentment.
elements.negative: Write it out, then ask what you need to feel better.
elements.positive: Letting it soften frees your energy for what is good.

elements.name: Boredom
elements.negative: Try something new, however small; move your body.
elements.positive: Boredom makes room for creativity; follow an idea.

elements.name: Calm
elements.negative: If calm feels like numbness, check in with what you feel.
elements.positive: Protect it with rest, nature, and slow breaths.

elements.name: Caring
elements.negative: If you are exhausted by it, care for yourself too.
elements.positive: Act on it with listening and kindness.

elements.name: Compassion
elements.definition: Feeling with someone who suffers and wanting to help.
elements.negative: If it drains you, set limits and refill your own cup.
elements.positive: Offer presence; it is often enough.

elements.name: Confidence
elements.negative: If it slips, list past things you handled.
elements.positive: Keep learning and stay open to feedback.

elements.name: Confusion
elements.definition: Not being sure what is happening or what to do.
elements.negative: Break it into parts and ask one clear question.
elements.positive: Questions lead to understanding; ask them.

elements.name: Contempt
elements.negative: Ask what hurt sits underneath and try curiosity instead.
elements.positive: Replace judgment with a boundary that respects both of you.

elements.name: Contentment
elements.definition: Being satisfied with what you have.
elements.negative: If it hides a wish for more, listen to it kindly.
elements.positive: Savor the moment and note what helped.

elements.name: Courage
elements.negative: If you feel you have none, take the smallest brave step.
elements.positive: Share your story; it gives others courage.

elements.name: Curiosity
elements.definition: Wanting to know or understand more.
elements.negative: If it leads to risk, pause and choose safe ways to explore.
elements.positive: Ask questions and try things.

elements.name: Defeat
elements.definition: Feeling beaten after a loss or failure.
elements.negative: Rest, then write one thing you learned.
elements.positive: Every try builds skill; try again differently.

elements.name: Delight
elements.negative: If you fear it will not last, enjoy it now anyway.
elements.positive: Share it and remember it.

elements.name: Denial
elements.definition: Not letting yourself see something painful.
elements.negative: Go gently; tell one safe person a little bit of the truth.
elements.positive: Facing truth slowly brings relief and choice.

elements.name: Dependence
elements.negative: Build small skills and supports so you are not left alone.
elements.positive: Healthy needs are human; ask openly and give back.

elements.name: Desire
elements.negative: If it controls you, wait a day before acting.
elements.positive: Turn it into a goal with steps.

elements.name: Despair
elements.definition: Feeling that nothing will get better.
elements.negative: Tell someone now; if you are in danger, call or text 988 (US) or local emergency services.
elements.positive: Feelings change; reaching out is the first step.

elements.name: Disappointment
elements.definition: Sadness when hopes are not met.
elements.negative: Let yourself feel it, then ask what is still possible.
elements.positive: New hopes can grow from old ones.

elements.name: Disgust
elements.definition: Strong rejection of something unpleasant or wrong.
elements.negative: Step away and breathe; protect yourself from what is harmful.
elements.positive: Use it to stand up for your values.

elements.name: Dismay
elements.definition: Upset at something unexpected and bad.
elements.negative: Pause and breathe before deciding.
elements.positive: Plan a next move; you can recover.

elements.name: Doubt
elements.definition: Not being sure it will work out.
elements.negative: Test it small and gather facts.
elements.positive: Healthy doubt makes plans better.

elements.name: Dread
elements.negative: Name it, plan one step, and share it with someone.
elements.positive: Facing it early usually shrinks it.

elements.name: Eagerness
elements.negative: Slow down so you do not skip steps.
elements.positive: Channel it into prepared action.

elements.name: Embarrassment
elements.negative: Remember it fades; breathe and laugh if you can.
elements.positive: Owning it makes you relatable.

elements.name: Empathy
elements.negative: If you absorb too much, take space.
elements.positive: Listen without fixing; it helps.

elements.name: Emptiness
elements.negative: Connect with one person or one small activity and tell someone.
elements.positive: Fill it slowly with what you value.

elements.name: Enthusiasm
elements.negative: If it fades, rest and remember why you started.
elements.positive: Invite others in.

elements.name: Envy
elements.negative: Ask what it shows you want.
elements.positive: Turn it into a goal and cheer others on.

elements.name: Euphoria
elements.negative: Keep your sleep and choices steady.
elements.positive: Enjoy it and remember it.

elements.name: Excitement
elements.negative: If nerves mix in, breathe and prepare.
elements.positive: Use the energy to act.

elements.name: Exhaustion
elements.definition: Deep tiredness of body or mind.
elements.negative: Rest, eat, drink water, and say no to extras.
elements.positive: Rest is part of growth.

elements.name: Fear
elements.negative: Check if the danger is real; breathe and ask for help.
elements.positive: Fear can protect you; use it as a guide.

elements.name: Forgiveness
elements.definition: Releasing the hold a hurt has on you.
elements.negative: You can forgive without staying close to someone harmful.
elements.positive: It frees you; go at your own pace.

elements.name: Frustration
elements.definition: Being blocked from what you want.
elements.negative: Take a break and try another route.
elements.positive: Persistence plus new ideas solves a lot.

elements.name: Fulfillment
elements.definition: Feeling your life matters and works.
elements.negative: If it feels out of reach, start with small purposeful acts.
elements.positive: Keep doing what feeds it.

elements.name: Gratitude
elements.negative: If it feels forced, start with something tiny.
elements.positive: Write or say three thanks a day.

elements.name: Grief
elements.negative: Cry, talk, and remember; do not rush it, and get support.
elements.positive: Honor what you loved and let others carry you.

elements.name: Guilt
elements.negative: Make it right if you can and learn from it.
elements.positive: Guilt shows your values; let it guide you.

elements.name: Happiness
elements.negative: If it feels unearned, accept it anyway.
elements.positive: Share it and build habits that keep it.

elements.name: Hatred
elements.negative: Step back; talk to someone safe about the hurt beneath.
elements.positive: Turn it into protecting what you love, without harm.

elements.name: Helplessness
elements.negative: Find one thing within your control and ask for help.
elements.positive: Small actions rebuild your sense of power.

elements.name: Hope
elements.negative: If it is fading, borrow hope from others' stories.
elements.positive: Pair it with a step.

elements.name: Hopelessness
elements.definition: Feeling there is no way forward.
elements.negative: Reach out today; call or text 988 (US) if you feel unsafe.
elements.positive: Others have felt this and found a way; you can too.

elements.name: Horror
elements.definition: Shock and fear at something terrible.
elements.negative: Get to safety, breathe, and talk to a trusted adult.
elements.positive: Support helps you recover.

elements.name: Hostility
elements.negative: Cool down and find out what you feel threatened by.
elements.positive: Replace it with firm, respectful words.

elements.name: Humiliation
elements.definition: Feeling shamed in front of others.
elements.negative: Remember it says more about the moment than your worth; talk to someone.
elements.positive: Rebuild by being kind to yourself.

elements.name: Hurt
elements.definition: Emotional pain from what someone said or did.
elements.negative: Name it and say it to someone safe.
elements.positive: Hurt heals with care and time.

elements.name: Inadequacy
elements.negative: List what you have done well and ask for support.
elements.positive: Growth, not perfection, is the goal.

elements.name: Indifference
elements.negative: Check if you are protecting yourself from hurt.
elements.positive: Care about one thing and act.

elements.name: Inspiration
elements.definition: A spark that moves you to create or act.
elements.negative: If it fades, write it down fast.
elements.positive: Start now, even small.

elements.name: Insecurity
elements.definition: Doubt about yourself or your place.
elements.negative: Notice your strengths and talk back to harsh thoughts.
elements.positive: Surround yourself with people who lift you.

elements.name: Irritation
elements.negative: Check hunger, sleep, and noise; take a break.
elements.positive: Express it calmly.

elements.name: Isolation
elements.negative: Message one person or join one activity.
elements.positive: Connection grows with small, steady reaches.

elements.name: Jealousy
elements.definition: Fear of losing someone or something to another.
elements.negative: Talk honestly about the fear instead of blaming.
elements.positive: Build trust and your own worth.

elements.name: Joy
elements.negative: If you fear it will go, savor it now.
elements.positive: Spread it.

elements.name: Kindness
elements.negative: Include yourself; kindness is not self-neglect.
elements.positive: One small kind act can change a day.

elements.name: Loneliness
elements.negative: Reach out, even briefly; join something with shared interests.
elements.positive: Be the friend you wish you had.

elements.name: Longing
elements.definition: Deep wish for someone or something absent.
elements.negative: Write to them or about it; stay with people near you.
elements.positive: Let it point to what matters.

elements.name: Love
elements.negative: If love hurts, protect your safety and boundaries.
elements.positive: Express it often and plainly.

elements.name: Loyalty
elements.definition: Staying faithful to people or values.
elements.negative: If it keeps you in harm, rethink it.
elements.positive: Be dependable and honest.

elements.name: Melancholy
elements.negative: Go outside, move, and talk.
elements.positive: Turn it into art or writing.

elements.name: Mistrust
elements.definition: Not feeling safe to rely on someone.
elements.negative: Go slowly and watch actions over time.
elements.positive: Trust is earned; give it in steps.

elements.name: Nervousness
elements.negative: Slow your breathing and prepare.
elements.positive: Nerves show you care.

elements.name: Nostalgia
elements.negative: Do not live in the past; add one new memory.
elements.positive: Share old stories to connect.

elements.name: Numbness
elements.negative: Warm water, movement, and talking to someone can help.
elements.positive: Feeling returns gently with care.

elements.name: Optimism
elements.negative: Balance it with a plan.
elements.positive: Use it to start things.

elements.name: Overwhelm
elements.negative: List everything, pick one thing, and ask for help.
elements.positive: One step at a time works.

elements.name: Panic
elements.negative: Breathe slowly, feel your feet on the floor, and tell yourself it will pass.
elements.positive: Practice calm skills when okay.

elements.name: Passion
elements.definition: Strong drive for something you love.
elements.negative: Guard your rest and relationships.
elements.positive: Give it time daily.

elements.name: Patience
elements.negative: If it is wearing thin, take a break.
elements.positive: It lets good things grow.

elements.name: Peace
elements.negative: If it feels fragile, return to your breath.
elements.positive: Protect it with routines you love.

elements.name: Pessimism
elements.negative: Ask what evidence supports it and what else could be true.
elements.positive: Use it to prepare, not to quit.

elements.name: Pity
elements.negative: Do not look down; walk beside them.
elements.positive: Turn it into helping.

elements.name: Pride
elements.definition: Satisfaction in your own or others' accomplishments.
elements.negative: If it blocks learning, stay humble.
elements.positive: Celebrate and encourage others.

elements.name: Regret
elements.negative: Learn, apologize if needed, and move on.
elements.positive: Let it guide your next choice.

elements.name: Rejection
elements.negative: It is not a verdict on your worth; lean on supportive people.
elements.positive: Keep trying where you are valued.

elements.name: Relief
elements.negative: Use the calm to rest.
elements.positive: Notice what helped.

elements.name: Remorse
elements.definition: Deep sorrow for harm you caused.
elements.negative: Apologize and repair.
elements.positive: Let it change your actions.

elements.name: Resentment
elements.negative: Say what you need and set a boundary.
elements.positive: Releasing it gives you energy.

elements.name: Resilience
elements.negative: Rest and ask for help; resilience is not doing it alone.
elements.positive: Remember what got you through.

elements.name: Respect
elements.negative: If it is not returned, protect yourself.
elements.positive: Give it freely and model it.

elements.name: Sadness
elements.definition: A low, heavy feeling after loss or disappointment.
elements.negative: Let tears come, talk, and do one gentle thing.
elements.positive: It deepens empathy.

elements.name: Satisfaction
elements.definition: Pleasure at having done well or having enough.
elements.negative: Do not let it end growth.
elements.positive: Celebrate and reflect.

elements.name: Self-Doubt
elements.definition: Questioning your own ability or worth.
elements.negative: Write what you have achieved and tell a supporter.
elements.positive: Take small risks to build trust in yourself.

elements.name: Serenity
elements.negative: Do not avoid problems; return to them calm.
elements.positive: Practice stillness daily.

elements.name: Shame
elements.definition: Feeling that you are bad, not just that you did something bad.
elements.negative: Share with someone safe; shame shrinks in kind company.
elements.positive: You are more than your mistakes.

elements.name: Shock
elements.negative: Sit, breathe, drink water, and get support.
elements.positive: Give yourself time to adjust.

elements.name: Shyness
elements.negative: Start small with one friendly hello.
elements.positive: Quiet people are good listeners.

elements.name: Sorrow
elements.negative: Lean on people and routines.
elements.positive: Sorrow honors what mattered.

elements.name: Stress
elements.negative: Move, sleep, and pare down.
elements.positive: Use it to prioritize.

elements.name: Surprise
elements.negative: Take a breath before reacting.
elements.positive: Stay curious.

elements.name: Suspicion
elements.negative: Check facts before deciding; do not assume.
elements.positive: It can protect you; ask questions.

elements.name: Sympathy
elements.negative: Do not take on their burden.
elements.positive: Offer kind words and help.

elements.name: Tenderness
elements.negative: Do not hide it out of fear.
elements.positive: Be gentle with others and yourself.

elements.name: Tension
elements.negative: Stretch, breathe, and unclench your jaw.
elements.positive: Release it daily.

elements.name: Terror
elements.negative: Get to safety and call for help.
elements.positive: Safe people help you recover.

elements.name: Trust
elements.definition: Feeling safe to rely on someone.
elements.negative: If broken, rebuild slowly.
elements.positive: Be trustworthy first.

elements.name: Uncertainty
elements.negative: Focus on today and what you control.
elements.positive: Uncertainty leaves room for good surprises.

elements.name: Vulnerability
elements.negative: Share with safe people only.
elements.positive: It builds real connection.

elements.name: Worry
elements.definition: Repeated thoughts about what could go wrong.
elements.negative: Write it down, then pick one action.
elements.positive: Share it; worry shrinks when spoken.

elements.name: Worthiness
elements.definition: Knowing you deserve care and belonging.
elements.negative: On low days, repeat it and ask someone who loves you.
elements.positive: Live it by treating yourself and others well.
